issue_request: FHIR-14391 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for FHIR-core Composition. It asked for Composition/$document to accept a GraphDefinition so generated documents could declare profiles and resource traversal rules; the final resolution was to add that GraphDefinition parameter.
initial_application: No current Git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-14391, but the Jira application comment records svn revision 13097. The current Git source lineage introduced source/composition/operationdefinition-Composition-document.xml in 2021 with the optional graph input parameter already present, preserving the historical application.
additional_context: FHIR-13856 is the same graph-parameter change family and is audited as an opportunistic issue. FHIR-13987 mentions the GraphDefinition part as a duplicate of FHIR-13856 while resolving a separate id/type-level declaration issue. Later FHIR-19974 removed the type-level [base]/Composition/$document form and id parameter, so FHIR-14391's speculative type-level/subject generation text should not drive a current source edit.
reconciliation: Made no source change. source/composition/operationdefinition-Composition-document.xml defines Composition/$document as an instance operation with a 0..1 input parameter named graph, type uri, documented as a canonical GraphDefinition reference controlling included resources and profiles.
